learning_outcomes.text: Students use command-line tools to connect to servers and exchange data.
They use server and client technologies to build simple communications between systems.
They set up a Node.js infrastructure and integrate web components to deliver content to the browser.
They know how to structure pages and are familiar with fundamental languages for designing websites (CSS, HTML, JavaScript).
They have written small JavaScript programs.
Based on this knowledge, students carry out their own project. They apply their knowledge of web technologies.
They evaluate the results of other groups and are themselves evaluated on their project.
Students have used standard web programming tools (GIT, Visual Code, Command Line).
After completing the course, students can carry out their own projects and develop Internet (web) applications.

syllabus_topics: Project work: Realization of an application
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of a project performance and a written examination. The project performance is graded according to a scheme. The written examination tests basic understanding and has a duration of 60 minutes.
